name: Elixir of Pain
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon prepares the Elixir of Pain for a field trial. Stanley, Farmer Ray’s dog in Hillsbrad Fields, is the chosen subject.

sections.title: Apothecary Science
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon works in Tarren Mill for the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. He gathers fresh blood from local wildlife and uses it to brew a volatile mixture called the Elixir of Pain. The Society seeks field evidence of how its experimental poisons and mutagens affect living bodies.

sections.title: Testing on Stanley
sections.body: Lydon sends his agents to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields, away from the human defenders. Farmer Ray keeps a pet dog there named Stanley. With the draught poured into an open hand, an agent offers it to the unsuspecting dog as an ordinary treat.

sections.title: Violent Mutation
sections.body: The Elixir of Pain brings Stanley immediate agony and a violent change. The brew is a mutagen, not a simple lethal toxin: it warps the dog into a savage, enraged wolf. The beast attacks whatever is nearby, revealing the force of Lydon’s alchemical formula.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Elixir of Pain?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon brewed the Elixir of Pain for the Royal Apothecary Society’s effort to create biological weapons and potent mutagens for Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken.
Stanley is Farmer Ray’s pet dog, living outside the large farmhouse at the northern end of Hillsbrad Fields.

faq.q: What happens when you feed Stanley the elixir?
aliases: what does elixir do to dog
faq.answer: Lydon wants to see how Stanley likes his “treat.” The elixir’s effect becomes clear when Stanley eats it.
Stanley wanders outside the large house on the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields, southwest of Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to test the elixir?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon, in the Forsaken settlement of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, asks you to test the elixir after you gather the needed reagents.

faq.q: Why test the potion on a farmer's dog instead of humans?
faq.answer: A domestic pet in Hillsbrad Fields offers a quiet, accessible trial without immediately alerting the town militia or armed guards to the alchemical test.

angles.text: As an undead, you see the Royal Apothecary Society’s ruthless approach: it seeks biological weapons for Forsaken survival, whatever the collateral damage.
As a Horde ally, you are drawn into the Forsaken’s grim chemical trials against the neighboring human farmlands of Hillsbrad.
As a hunter, you see how little Forsaken alchemists care for the beasts caught in their trials when they feed an experimental brew to a farmer’s trusting dog.
